svg.title: Engineering pulse — real project commits
svg.desc: 1111 commits across five public projects, 67 active days, peak 126 commits per day. 2026-09-01 through 2026-11-23 UTC. Each column represents one day; height is proportional to commit count. All authors, default branches, merge commits included. Snapshot 2026-11-23T03:03:37.747Z.
